content:
Create a premium, high-converting Gurugram real-estate landing page for the project information provided in the dashboard.

IMPORTANT:
This page should be inspired by the visual and conversion patterns seen across premium Gurugram real-estate websites such as DLF Privana, Godrej Vrikshya, Signature Global Titanium SPR, M3M projects, Emaar Urban Ascent and Smartworld One DXP.

DO NOT copy their exact text, logos, imagery, unique layouts, or brand identity.
Create an ORIGINAL website that feels like a premium Indian luxury real-estate developer website while using the research patterns below.

==================================================
1. OVERALL DESIGN DIRECTION
==================================================

Design language:
- Ultra-premium
- Architectural
- Sophisticated
- Minimal but visually rich
- Editorial luxury real estate
- High-end Gurgaon/Gurugram property aesthetic
- Strong photography and whitespace
- Conversion-focused without looking like an aggressive sales website
- Avoid generic real-estate-template appearance

The website should feel closer to a luxury property brochure converted into a modern website.

Use large architectural imagery, controlled typography, asymmetrical sections, generous whitespace, elegant cards and subtle scroll animations.

Avoid:
- Cheap gradients
- Excessive rounded cards
- Excessive icons
- Emoji
- Bright multi-colour UI
- Overcrowded layouts
- Stock-looking generic real-estate illustrations
- Excessive text above the fold

==================================================
2. COLOUR SYSTEM
==================================================

Use a refined luxury palette based on the strongest visual characteristics found across premium Gurugram developers.

Primary:
- Deep Charcoal: #111111
- Near Black: #080808
- Warm Ivory: #F7F4EE
- Pure White: #FFFFFF

Secondary:
- Architectural Grey: #4D4D4F
- Soft Grey: #E9E7E2

Luxury Accent:
- Champagne Gold: #C8A96B

Optional restrained property accent:
- Muted Blue: #0B5A7E

RULE:
Gold must be used sparingly for:
- CTA accents
- Thin dividers
- Small highlights
- Numbers
- Hover states
- Premium labels

Do NOT make the entire website gold.

Most of the interface should remain black/white/ivory/grey with carefully controlled accent colour.

==================================================
3. TYPOGRAPHY
==================================================

Primary display/headline font:
- Optima
- Use Optima Bold / Medium where available

Secondary/body font:
- Inter, Arial or another clean modern sans-serif fallback

Typography hierarchy:
- Large elegant display headlines
- Medium-weight subheadings
- Compact uppercase eyebrow labels
- Comfortable body line-height
- Large numerical statistics

Use letter spacing carefully.

Example:
EYEBROW
LIMITED COLLECTION

H1
A New Standard
of Elevated Living

Body:
A refined residential address designed around architecture, space,
connectivity and an elevated everyday lifestyle.

==================================================
4. HEADER / NAVIGATION
==================================================

Create a premium sticky navigation.

Desktop:
- Project logo / developer logo on left
- Navigation in center:
  Overview
  Residences
  Amenities
  Gallery
  Location
  Plans
- CTA on right:
  BOOK A SITE VISIT

Header should initially sit transparently over the hero image and transform into a solid ivory/white or dark header after scrolling.

Mobile:
- Compact logo
- Hamburger menu
- Persistent enquiry CTA

==================================================
5. HERO SECTION
==================================================

Create an immersive full-screen hero section, approximately 80–95vh.

Use a high-quality architectural image/render of the property as the dominant visual.

Hero composition:
- subtle dark overlay for readability
- small uppercase eyebrow
- project name
- powerful luxury headline
- location
- key property information
- primary CTA
- secondary CTA

Example structure:

PREMIUM RESIDENCES • GURUGRAM

[PROJECT NAME]

Live Above
The Ordinary.

[Sector / Location] | [Configuration] | [Property Type]

Starting from ₹[PRICE]*

[BOOK A SITE VISIT]
[DOWNLOAD BROCHURE]

Add subtle scroll indicator at bottom.

The hero must immediately communicate:
1. What the project is
2. Where it is
3. Why it is premium
4. What action the visitor should take

==================================================
6. QUICK PROPERTY STATS
==================================================

Immediately after the hero create a refined horizontal statistics strip.

Use 4–5 items:

[LAND PARCEL]
[UNITS]
[CONFIGURATION]
[OPEN/GREEN SPACE]
[PRICE / STATUS]

Example:

18 ACRES
1,152 RESIDENCES
4 BHK
80% OPEN SPACE
BOOKINGS OPEN

Numbers should be visually prominent.

Use thin separators rather than heavy cards.

==================================================
7. PROJECT STORY
==================================================

Create a two-column editorial section.

Left:
Large architectural/lifestyle image

Right:
Small eyebrow
PROJECT OVERVIEW

Large heading:
Designed Around
The Way You Live.

Then 2–3 short paragraphs explaining:
- architectural concept
- lifestyle positioning
- location
- nature/open space
- privacy
- luxury
- daily convenience

Keep copy elegant and concise.

Do not create huge blocks of text.

==================================================
8. SIGNATURE FEATURES
==================================================

Create a visually rich section called:

THE EXPERIENCE

Show 4–6 signature features.

Examples:
- Panoramic Views
- Grand Arrival Lobby
- Private Decks
- Resort-Style Club
- Landscaped Gardens
- Smart Home Features

Use large image cards with short descriptions.

Do not use basic icon-only cards.

Each card should feel editorial and premium.

==================================================
9. AMENITIES SECTION
==================================================

Create an immersive amenities section inspired by luxury hospitality websites.

Heading:

EVERYTHING WITHIN REACH

Use a visual grid with categories such as:

Wellness
- Gymnasium
- Spa
- Yoga

Leisure
- Swimming Pool
- Clubhouse
- Lounge

Sports
- Tennis
- Badminton
- Jogging Track

Family
- Kids Zone
- Community Lawn
- Multipurpose Hall

Use premium imagery wherever possible.

==================================================
10. GALLERY
==================================================

Create a sophisticated editorial gallery.

Do NOT use a boring 3x3 identical grid.

Use:
- one large feature image
- two smaller supporting images
- alternating image sizes
- subtle hover zoom
- image captions

Categories:
Architecture
Interiors
Landscape
Amenities
Lifestyle

Clicking an image should open a clean lightbox.

==================================================
11. RESIDENCES / FLOOR PLANS
==================================================

Create a premium floor-plan section.

Title:

SPACES WITH INTENTION

Use tabs/cards:

[3 BHK]
[3.5 BHK]
[4 BHK]
[PENTHOUSE]

Each tab should show:
- floor-plan image
- unit size
- configuration
- key features
- CTA: VIEW PLAN

Do not invent dimensions or prices.
Use only information supplied in the dashboard.

==================================================
12. LOCATION SECTION
==================================================

Create a high-end location section.

Heading:

CONNECTED TO WHAT MATTERS.

Show:
- map
- project location
- major connectivity points
- approximate drive times only when supplied in the data

Example categories:
Airport
Metro
Business District
Expressway
Schools
Hospitals
Retail

Present connectivity as elegant horizontal cards or timeline elements rather than a giant paragraph.

==================================================
13. LIFESTYLE / EMOTIONAL SECTION
==================================================

Create one dramatic full-width image section.

Overlay a large emotional statement such as:

A HOME THAT FEELS
LIKE AN ARRIVAL.

Then a short supporting paragraph.

This section should create emotional aspiration before the next conversion section.

==================================================
14. DEVELOPER TRUST SECTION
==================================================

Create:

THE DEVELOPER

Include:
- Developer logo
- short developer overview
- years/legacy
- delivered projects
- credibility metrics
- certifications/awards only if supplied

Use 3–4 numerical trust indicators.

Example:

30+
YEARS OF EXPERIENCE

50+
PROJECTS

X MILLION SQ. FT.
DELIVERED

Do NOT invent company statistics.

==================================================
15. TESTIMONIALS
==================================================

Add a clean testimonial section only when testimonial information is available.

Style:
- large quote
- name
- designation/category if available
- optional portrait

Use subtle transitions.

==================================================
16. CONVERSION SECTION
==================================================

Create a premium dark section near the end.

Headline:

YOUR NEXT ADDRESS
STARTS HERE.

Supporting copy:
Schedule a private site visit or request the project brochure.

Form fields:
- Full Name
- Phone Number
- Email
- Preferred Configuration

Buttons:
BOOK A SITE VISIT
GET BROCHURE

Also provide:
- WhatsApp
- Call now

The form should look premium and trustworthy, not like a generic lead-generation popup.

==================================================
17. FAQ
==================================================

Create 6–8 expandable FAQ items.

Possible topics:
- project location
- configuration
- sizes
- amenities
- possession
- RERA
- site visit
- brochure
- pricing

Only use factual information supplied in the project data.

Never fabricate answers.

==================================================
18. FOOTER / COMPLIANCE
==================================================

Create a minimal premium footer.

Include:
- developer/project logo
- contact details
- quick links
- privacy policy
- terms
- RERA information
- statutory disclaimer

The disclaimer should clearly distinguish:
- artistic impressions
- actual images
- indicative pricing
- availability
- approvals
- project specifications

Do not create fake RERA numbers.

==================================================
19. CTA STRATEGY
==================================================

Use multiple conversion opportunities throughout the page, but do not make them visually aggressive.

Primary CTA:
BOOK A SITE VISIT

Secondary CTA:
DOWNLOAD BROCHURE

Other contextual CTAs:
VIEW FLOOR PLANS
REQUEST PRICE
TALK TO AN ADVISOR

Add a sticky mobile bottom bar:

CALL
WHATSAPP
BOOK VISIT

==================================================
20. ANIMATION / INTERACTION
==================================================

Use subtle premium animations:
- fade-up on scroll
- image reveal
- slow image zoom
- smooth section transitions
- understated hover effects
- number count-up only for verified statistics
- sticky header transition
- smooth scrolling

Avoid:
- excessive bouncing
- flashy animations
- parallax everywhere
- distracting loaders

The result should feel expensive, calm and architectural.

==================================================
21. RESPONSIVE DESIGN
==================================================

Desktop:
- 1440px premium layout
- large editorial sections
- generous spacing

Tablet:
- intelligently collapse grids
- preserve hierarchy

Mobile:
- single-column layout
- full-width imagery
- readable typography
- sticky bottom CTA
- easy-to-use forms
- no horizontal scrolling

Hero must remain visually impressive on mobile.

==================================================
22. IMAGE DIRECTION
==================================================

Prioritize:
- realistic architectural renders
- luxury residential exteriors
- dusk/evening tower photography
- premium interiors
- landscaped gardens
- pools
- clubhouse
- lifestyle scenes
- aerial project views
- location/map visuals

Images should have consistent colour grading.

Avoid generic stock photography unless project images are unavailable.

When project images are provided, prioritize those over generated replacements.

==================================================
23. COPYWRITING STYLE
==================================================

Tone:
- sophisticated
- confident
- premium
- modern
- emotionally aspirational
- concise

Use short luxury headlines.

Examples:

CRAFTED FOR ELEVATED LIVING

WHERE SPACE MEETS SERENITY

THE ADDRESS OF TOMORROW

A HIGHER STANDARD OF HOME

DESIGNED FOR THE LIFE YOU ENVISION

Avoid cliché-heavy copy such as:
"Dream home comes true"
"Paradise on earth"
"Best project in Gurgaon"
"Unmatched investment opportunity"

Do not make unsupported superiority claims.

==================================================
24. DATA SAFETY / ACCURACY
==================================================

CRITICAL:

Use only project information supplied by the dashboard/user.

Never invent:
- pricing
- unit sizes
- number of towers
- number of units
- possession date
- RERA number
- awards
- developer statistics
- amenities
- connectivity times
- investment returns

When information is missing:
- hide that field, OR
- use a neutral placeholder such as "[PRICE ON REQUEST]"

Never create fake factual information.

==================================================
25. FINAL VISUAL RESULT
==================================================

The final website should combine:

DLF-style restrained luxury
+
Godrej-style lifestyle storytelling
+
Signature Global-style rich content depth
+
M3M-style immersive visual storytelling
+
Emaar-style elegant typography and monochrome sophistication
+
Smartworld-style high-conversion CTA structure

But the final result MUST be an ORIGINAL design.

The website should look like a premium Gurugram luxury real-estate campaign created by a professional brand/design agency, not a generic AI-generated property template.

Priority:
1. Visual impact
2. Premium typography
3. Strong first impression
4. Clear property information
5. Lead generation
6. Mobile responsiveness
7. Trust and compliance
8. Fast loading

Build the complete landing page, not just a hero section.
